 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
   

  

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
   

  

**About the role:**
 Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is seeking a Data Scientist to advance our data\-driven efforts in sales, marketing, and customer success. As part of the Data Science and AI team in Revenue Operations, this role focuses on designing and delivering predictive models, refining AI\-based scripts to validate, augment, and test the accuracy of business critical data, and establishing the quality measurement, lineage, and input pipelines of that data. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders in BizTech, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to unlock insights, automate processes, and enhance the operational efficiency of the sales organization.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires 2 days per week in our Bangalore office and 3 days working remotely. This position requires working hours in IST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.**
**Who We Are**
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations in physical operations to harness IoT and AI to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Our customers span essential industries like transportation, manufacturing, field services, agriculture, and construction.
   

  

 As part of Samsara’s Revenue Operations AI \& Data Science team, you’ll be helping to define how AI transforms our sales, marketing, and customer success functions. Your work will power intelligent decisions at scale, enhancing operational efficiency and unlocking actionable insights from complex data.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Estimate revenue opportunity models and conduct impact analysis as part of the annual strategic planning cycle to guide GTM and investment decisions.
* Leverage LLMs and other AI tools to systematically validate account\-level data, enabling dynamic quality measurement scores and continuous trust in business\-critical data.
* Generate predictive models and triangulate from multiple inputs—CRMs, web data, third\-party signals—to drive data accuracy and establish reliable sources of truth.
* Establish scalable data pipelines from internal systems to generate and sustain baseline data programs supporting cross\-functional initiatives.
* Contribute to the development of predictive analytics tools, such as sales performance dashboards, pipeline forecasting models, and KPI frameworks, to enhance operational efficiency.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing Ops, BizTech, and Enablement teams to automate insights, enrich GTM execution, and accelerate business outcomes.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 4 \- 7 years of experience in data science, AI engineering, or advanced analytics roles.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and tools such as Tableau for building analytics and dashboards.
* Experience developing and deploying ML models to support sales/revenue strategies.
* Hands\-on experience with CRMs and sales/marketing data pipelines.
* Exposure to LLM\-based tools and GenAI for data enrichment or automation tasks.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with MLOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes), model versioning, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with AI observability, monitoring, and guardrail implementation for responsible AI.
* Exposure to ETL/data engineering processes and modern cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Strong business acumen and curiosity to understand operational processes in physical industries, strong attention to detail.
* Experience analyzing B2B marketing channels, account\-level data accuracy, and lifecycle optimization.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, able to work from 0 → 1 and iterate rapidly in ambiguous environments.


**Total Rewards**
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
   

  

**Flexible Working**
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
   

  

**Belonging at Samsara**
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**
 We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Gen AI Researcher
description:
**Role:** 
 Gen AI Researcher – Reasoning \& Benchmarks
 



**Function:** 
 AI Research
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Information Technology \& Services
 



  





**About Company** 




 A research\-first AI company incubated at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc). The company builds advanced AI for the planning and operations of critical networks.
 



 Its core technology is a World Model that augments LLMs to reason about network state and dependencies, even with limited or noisy data. The founding team has raised over $100M in prior ventures and published at leading AI research venues.
 



 Having just closed its seed round, the company is assembling a team of ambitious, frontier\-focused researchers.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This role sits at the core of the company's research agenda — designing and building reasoning benchmarks across science and engineering domains to rigorously evaluate AI systems at the frontier of reasoning and planning. You will build evaluation infrastructure, develop agents, and iterate on them against real\-world science and engineering tasks. You'll work directly with the founders and IISc faculty in a lean, research\-driven environment where your output shapes the company's technical direction.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and validate reasoning benchmarks spanning science and engineering domains, ensuring rigor and reproducibility
* Develop evaluation pipelines using eval harnesses and benchmark suites (e.g., SWE\-bench) to systematically assess AI system performance
* Build and iterate on agents capable of tackling complex reasoning and planning tasks, guided by benchmark results
* Contribute to the company's core research agenda — document methodologies, findings, and experimental results to publication\-ready standards
* Collaborate closely with IISc faculty, and internal research, agent, and data teams to align benchmark design with real\-world network planning problems
* Engage with the open\-source research community to stay current with and contribute to frontier developments in reasoning and evaluation



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* BTech from a top\-tier institute (IITs/IISc/BITS or equivalent) with 2\+ years of relevant AI/ML research experience, OR MTech/PhD from a top\-tier institute
* Solid foundations in probability, statistics, and machine learning — demonstrable through coursework, research, or published work
* Hands\-on experience with evaluation harnesses and benchmark suites (e.g., SWE\-bench or comparable frameworks)
* Strong coding and software engineering skills sufficient to build and maintain reproducible research pipelines
* Demonstrated ability to build and iterate on AI agents for reasoning or planning tasks



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior publications at leading AI research venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or equivalent)
* Prior experience designing or contributing to benchmark datasets or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with network planning, operations research, or science/engineering simulation domains
* Experience working in early\-stage or research\-lab environments with high autonomy



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct collaboration with IISc faculty and a founding team with a track record of $100M\+ raised and frontier AI publications
* Ownership over a core research function at a seed\-stage company building at the frontier of reasoning AI
* Opportunity to publish and contribute to the broader AI research community as part of your role
* Lean, research\-first culture with high autonomy and cross\-disciplinary exposure across agents, data, and network AI

title: Manager
description:
As the Manager, Market \& Competitive Intelligence (MI/CI), you will lead the strategy, transformation, and execution of global intelligence and insights capabilities that enable data\-driven business decisions across commercial and therapeutic areas. This role will be responsible for driving the evolution of traditional MI/CI functions through the adoption of advanced analytics, AI, and Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, creating scalable intelligence solutions that accelerate insight generation and decision\-making.
 



 You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior business leaders, leveraging market research, competitive intelligence, social listening, secondary and primary research, and AI\-powered intelligence platforms to identify market opportunities, competitive threats, emerging trends, and strategic implications. The role will also oversee the modernization of MI/CI operating models, processes, and technology ecosystems to deliver faster, more actionable, and predictive insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& Capability Transformation** 



* Define and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Market Intelligence and Competitive Intelligence capabilities across key therapeutic, commercial, and strategic business priorities.
* Drive the modernization of MI/CI functions through the adoption of advanced analytics, automation, AI, and Generative AI technologies.
* Establish scalable intelligence frameworks, operating models, and best practices that improve speed, consistency, and business impact of insight generation.
* Build and execute a digital transformation roadmap for MI/CI, incorporating emerging technologies, external data assets, and knowledge management capabilities.



**AI \& GenAI Innovation** 



* Lead the design and implementation of GenAI\-powered MI/CI solutions including intelligence copilots, automated literature monitoring, competitive signal detection, insight generation, and executive briefing tools.
* Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and advanced search technologies to improve intelligence gathering and synthesis.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual research processes and enhance analyst productivity through AI\-enabled workflows.
* Partner with Data Science, AI, Product, and Technology teams to develop next\-generation intelligence solutions and drive enterprise adoption.



**Stakeholder Engagement \& Strategic Advisory** 



* Act as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership, collaborating across Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Business Development, and Strategy functions.
* Deliver forward\-looking market, competitor, and industry insights that influence key business decisions, product strategy, portfolio planning, and investment priorities.
* Facilitate executive\-level discussions by translating complex information into concise strategic recommendations.



**Research \& Intelligence Leadership** 



* Oversee a portfolio of secondary research, primary research, competitive intelligence, social listening, market monitoring, and strategic intelligence programs.
* Guide the development of competitive landscapes, market trend assessments, KOL insights, conference intelligence, pipeline tracking, and strategic scenario analysis.
* Ensure methodological rigor, quality assurance, and alignment to business priorities across all intelligence initiatives.



**Insight Generation \& Storytelling** 



* Synthesize diverse data sources, market signals, and competitive developments into clear, actionable insights and strategic implications.
* Deliver high\-impact executive presentations, dashboards, and intelligence products tailored for senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Drive adoption of advanced visualization, storytelling, and insight communication best practices.



**Vendor \& Ecosystem Management** 



* Lead relationships with external research agencies, intelligence providers, data partners, and technology vendors.
* Evaluate emerging MI/CI platforms, AI solutions, and data sources to continuously enhance organizational intelligence capabilities.
* Ensure cost\-effective execution, vendor performance, and data quality standards.



**Governance \& Excellence** 



* Establish governance frameworks for intelligence generation, AI adoption, research quality, knowledge management, and insight dissemination.
* Define KPIs and success measures to evaluate the impact of intelligence activities on business outcomes.
* Promote innovation, continuous improvement, and best practices across the MI/CI organization.



**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 



* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of MI/CI professionals, fostering a culture of strategic thinking, innovation, and analytical excellence.
* Develop future\-ready capabilities across market research, competitive intelligence, analytics, and AI\-driven intelligence methodologies.
* Champion continuous learning and upskilling in emerging AI and GenAI technologies.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **10\-12\+ years of experience** 
 in Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Strategic Insights, Commercial Analytics, or Market Research within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
* Should have worked on GenAI projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale MI/CI programs and influencing senior executives through strategic insights and intelligence.
* Proven experience modernizing intelligence capabilities through digital transformation, advanced analytics, AI, and Generative AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialization, competitive landscape analysis, market dynamics, pipeline intelligence, and strategic planning.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/GenAI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, enterprise search, and intelligent knowledge management platforms.

title: AI Engineering - Contractor
description:
**Company Description** **About our US client.**


PiggyBank Ventures is an incubator building AI\-first consumer applications. We are currently building Nestora \- an AI\-powered mobile app that helps people manage communication intelligently. This is applied AI at the edge: limited context, small models, real\-time performance, and messy data. Accuracy and reliability matter.


Our team includes repeat founders and operators with experience building and scaling products, along with backgrounds from top\-tier universities and technical programs.

 **Job Description**  

This is not a passive role. You will work directly on the AI systems powering a product heading to market \- one where the AI operates within the tight constraints of a mobile phone environment, dealing with limited screen context, predicting user inputs, and real\-time performance demands.


Your work will influence real product decisions and ship to users. For the right candidate, this role can expand into broader ownership across product quality and system design

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and improve prompts for classification and extraction tasks
* Run structured evaluation cycles (accuracy, error analysis, iteration)
* Build datasets for testing and validation
* Analyze outputs from real usage (logs, SQLite data, structured results)
* Write Python scripts for testing, scoring, and comparisons
* Identify failure patterns and propose improvements
* Validate system behavior in iOS simulation environments
* Document findings in a clear and structured manner

  

**Qualifications** **What We’re Looking For**


We care most about problem\-solving ability and a bias toward action — credentials matter less than evidence you can think clearly and ship things.

* Currently pursuing a Masters degree in CS, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field with a Bachelor’s degree in CS
* Experience shipping at least one production\-grade mobile app
* Strong proficiency in React Native, Expo, and iOS ecosystem
* Python proficiency for scripting and data validation
* Experience working with APIs and local databases (SQLite or similar)
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Experience or formal training with LLMs and prompt engineering
* Clear and proactive communication
* Availability for full\-time (or near full\-time) internship
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to analyze results and iterate systematically

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If**

* You have no experience with mobile app development
* Your experience with AI tools is limited to basic usage
* All of your experience is from coursework only
* You prefer well\-defined assignments with clear answers
* You are not interested in analyzing and debugging system failures

  

**Additional Information** **Work Timing \- 7:30pm IST to 4:30 am IST**

**Or may be flexible with a half day overlap with US teams \- 3pm to 12am IST shift maybe**

title: Senior Manager — Industry Domain (Credit Decisioning)
description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI\-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000\+ users across 70\+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.
 



  





**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo** 




  





 Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. Our platform's human\-centric design, coupled with enterprise\-grade scalability and AI\-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.
 



  





**Recognition \& Trust** 




  





 ● Backed by $45M\+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.
 



 ● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!
 



 ● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.
 



 ● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a
 



 "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.
 



 ● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Credit decisions at scale — whether a loan gets approved, at what rate, under what conditions — are governed by business rule engines and decision frameworks that have been refined over decades inside banks, NBFCs, and risk analytics firms. Vymo's agentic AI systems interact with, augment, and in some cases replace components of these decisioning frameworks.
 



  





 Building the right system requires someone who understands how business rule engines actually work: how rules are authored, versioned, tested, and deployed; how credit policy translates into decision logic; where the standard engines fall short and where manual override is still the norm. That is this role.
 



  





 You are the person who sits between a client's risk team and Vymo's product team — making sure that what is being built reflects how credit decisioning actually works in a regulated Indian financial institution, not how a software team imagines it works. You will carry domain knowledge from the BRE layer through to the underwriting policy and credit risk framework that sits above it.
 



  





***The crux of this role: you know enough about credit decisioning and BRE architecture to know which questions, asked in which sequence, reveal how a client's decision engine actually works — and what Vymo needs to build to sit alongside it or replace it.***




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**1\. Client Discovery — Decode the Decision Engine** 



* Diagnose architectural realities and data flows by asking targeted questions that reveal system dependencies, latencies, and integration requirements.
* Translate discovered logic gaps into actionable visual maps and precise engineering specifications for the product team.



**2\. Product Requirements — Translate Decisioning Logic Into What to Build** 



* Translate credit decisioning and Business Rule Engine (BRE) logic into precise product specifications for Vymo's agentic layer, defining routing, rule execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop interventions.
* Validate technical assumptions against BFSI deployment cycles while mapping major BRE platforms (e.g., SAS, Experian, FICO) to ensure architectural accuracy.



**3\. GTM Support — Lend Credibility to the Technical Sales Conversation** 



* Partner with sales teams in high\-stakes sessions to provide deep architectural credibility and handle advanced technical inquiries regarding BRE and decisioning systems.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client architects and risk heads, auditing technical proposals and developing GTM assets that address platform constraints and regulatory governance.



**4\. Industry Intelligence — Track How Decisioning Is Evolving** 



* Track RBI regulatory changes—including the Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF) and AI explainability rules—alongside Indian BRE market trends to anticipate compliance demands.
* Build a strong network of industry experts to validate core architecture choices and feed real\-world market insights directly into the product roadmap.



  





**What You will Bring** 




  





**Experience \& Fluency** 




  




* **Domain Background:** 
 Operational depth in credit decisioning across key sectors—whether coming from BRE vendors (SAS, FICO, Experian), bank/NBFC credit risk teams, underwriting operations, risk consulting, or credit bureaus.
* **BRE \& Risk Architecture:** 
 Deep understanding of Business Rule Engine (BRE) architectures, rule authoring, champion\-challenger frameworks, scorecard calibration, and baseline risk concepts ($PD/LGD/EAD$).
* **Origination \& Integration Landscape: Practical knowledge of Loan Origination System (LOS) integration patterns, core platform configurations (e.g., PowerCurve, Blaze Advisor), and performance metrics like Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.**
* **Regulatory \& Compliance Context:** 
 Familiarity with RBI guidelines regarding algorithmic credit decisions, model risk management, explainability requirements, and cloud data localisation constraints.



  





**Mindset \& Core Traits** 




  




* **Architectural Inquiry:** 
 Driven by deep curiosity about how entire systems fit together, possessing the precise sequence of targeted questions that uncover how a client’s engine
 *actually* 
 operates beneath the documentation.
* **Skeptical Practitioner:** 
 Operates with a healthy skepticism of stated architectures; validates system realities by analyzing deployment logs, rule histories, and exception reports rather than relying solely on official diagrams.
* **Policy\-to\-Logic Translation:** 
 Seamlessly bridges the gap between high\-level credit policy language and structured, actionable rule engine engineering specifications.
* **Grounded Intellectual Humility:** 
 Explicitly understands the boundaries of personal technical knowledge, prioritizing accurate discovery and domain\-expert networking over making unverified assumptions.

title: Senior Manager Global Pricing
description:
**About Us** 




  





 Headquartered in Singapore, SATS Ltd. is one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. SATS Food Solutions serves airlines and institutions and operates central kitchens with large\-scale food production and distribution capabilities for a wide range of cuisines.

**About Us**
 WRI India, an independent knowledge organization registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development.

**Program Overview For Energy**
 The objective of the WRI India energy program is to inform and guide India’s transition to cleaner energy through strong research, ground\-level implementation experience, partnerships with key stakeholders and communicating our work. The 5 pillars of the energy program focus on increasing clean energy demand, increasing clean energy supply, supporting sub\-national energy transitions, raising the issues of materials and circularity for the energy transition and ensuring equitable development through energy transitions.
   

  

**About IRP**
 Under this initiative we work with states on Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and to support the translation of state energy\-transition priorities into implementable plans, infrastructure requirements and investment pathways. title: Historical Market Data (HMD)
description:
**Why Mizuho** 




  





 At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone
 



  





 It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



  





 The Historical Market Data (HMD) team is a specialist function within Enterprise Risk responsible for the quality, completeness, and controlled implementation of market risk time series used in Value at Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR), stress testing, and related risk and capital calculations.
 



 Reporting to the Head of Risk Appetite and Capital Analysis, the candidate will own front\-to\-back onboarding and maintenance of historical risk\-factor data across spot, curves, spreads, and volatility surfaces. The role requires strong understanding of market risk time\-series construction, returns and shock generation, proxy and backfill methodologies, data\-quality controls, and the downstream impact of data changes on risk measures. The successful candidate will work closely with Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  




* Lead front\-to\-back onboarding of historical market data and risk\-factor time series, including spot, curve, spread, and volatility surface data.
* Manage time\-series implementations end to end, covering requirements analysis, data sourcing, mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and production delivery.
* Assess the suitability and completeness of market data used in VaR, SVaR, stress testing, FRTB, and related capital calculations.
* Perform data\-quality analysis across completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, outliers, stale observations, and risk\-factor coverage.
* Develop, document, and enhance proxy and backfilling methodologies for illiquid, sparse, or unavailable historical time series.
* Conduct quantitative impact assessments for data\-source changes, history extensions, methodology updates, and proxy enhancements.
* Investigate material data exceptions and production issues, identify root causes, and drive remediation with Risk Analytics and Technology teams.
* Partner with Quantitative Analytics and Market Risk stakeholders on risk\-factor modelling, methodology changes, and model\-data requirements.
* Define test scenarios, execute UAT and regression testing, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for HMD platform changes.
* Contribute to automation, monitoring, and tooling enhancements that improve the scalability, transparency, and control of time\-series management.
* Prepare management information on data quality, proxy usage, backfilling activity, risk\-factor coverage, exceptions, and remediation progress.
* Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, source selection, transformations, proxy logic, controls, approvals, and implementation outcomes.
* Support governance, audit, model\-risk, and regulatory reviews relating to historical market data and market risk measurement.



  





  





 Qualifications and Experience:
 



  




* Master's degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 5\-12 years of relevant experience within Market Risk Time series, Quantitative Risk, Risk Analytics, Market Data, Product Control, or a closely related function in a bank or financial institution.
* Hands\-on experience with historical time\-series data, market\-data validation, proxy construction, backfilling, risk\-factor mapping, or data\-quality controls.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and communicate quantitative issues clearly.
* Effective stakeholder\-management skills and the ability to work across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and control functions.
* Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, validation, automation, and investigation; advanced Excel proficiency required.
* Experience working with large\-scale historical time\-series datasets and applying statistical techniques to identify gaps, outliers, and structural data issues.
* Familiarity with market\-data vendors, risk engines, or platforms such as Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv, Murex, MSCI RiskMetrics, or equivalent systems is advantageous.
* CFA, FRM, CQF, or an equivalent professional qualification is advantageous.



  





**Organization Overview:** 




  





 Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.
 



  





 MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.
 



  





 MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices. MGS Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

 As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in\-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
   

  

**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**
* Define Insurance Policies \& Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance\-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross\-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data \& Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes \& Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance \& Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance\-related quality questions.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5\+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.

**Benefits**

title: Senior Associate, Clean Fuels Markets
description:
cKinetics is looking for an energetic Senior Associate who is passionate about clean fuel markets and the energy transition and is looking to lead projects and teams doing meaningful, cutting\-edge work.
 



  





 We work across compliance clean fuel markets, including California LCFS, Washington CFS, Oregon CFP, Canada CFR, and BC LCFS, as well as low\-carbon fuels such as Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), Renewable Diesel (RD), and Renewable Natural Gas (RNG). Through our market intelligence, analytical models, and data\-driven products, we help businesses, investors, and policymakers navigate the rapidly evolving global clean fuels and energy transition landscape.
 



  





 We are looking for individuals who thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to build new capabilities, take ownership, and contribute to the growth of both our products and the organization.
 



  





**Be on the cutting edge of researching the next generation of clean fuels.** 




  





**Role** 




 The role involves assessing and evaluating research elements to produce required outputs for client deliveries. Deliverables include creative presentations and narratives backed by market analysis, data insights, and modelling.
 



 The candidate will:
 


* Develop an understanding of the different drivers and constraints impacting specific markets within the clean fuels space.
* Manage end\-to\-end project delivery, including overseeing team members working on assigned projects.
* Guide team members in undertaking primary and secondary research and formulating appropriate solution frameworks.
* Support practice leadership in developing collateral such as white papers, intelligence briefs, and business proposals.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sector and Industry Research** 



* Undertake analysis of global and regional clean fuel programs, with a specific focus on North America and the EU.
* Monitor legislative changes and market developments and assess their impact on respective clean fuel markets and programs.
* Lead conversations with clients, advisors, and external market participants globally and help solve client problems.
* Identify patterns and trends in data to draw conclusions, make inferences, and build spreadsheet\-based models.



**Project \& Time Management** 



* Plan and execute projects with team members, adhering to task completion timelines through self\-monitoring and coordination with Analysts to ensure high\-quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with project and internal teams, including Engagement Managers, Directors, and Partners, to develop cohesive solutions for client projects, problems, programs, and products.
* Own delivery of on\-demand consulting projects, ensuring timely and cost\-effective delivery with the requisite level of client satisfaction.



**Client Engagement** 



* Ensure client satisfaction through analytical, impactful, and world\-class written and oral presentations backed by data insights, trends, and patterns derived from structured and unstructured data analysis.
* Create customized client retention strategies through high\-engagement activities.



**Business Development Support** 



* Provide business development support by undertaking active pursuits with existing and potential cKinetics clients. This will include developing proposals, concept notes, and other collateral as needed to present cKinetics' capabilities.
* Develop innovative solutions and aim to generate new intellectual property in these markets through new product offerings, thematic topics, and emerging developments.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate must have the desire to work in sustainability transition interventions and have the following mindset and skill sets:
 


* Proactive and independent, with a passion for sustainability.
* Flexible and creative mindset, with the ability to understand diverse markets and client organizations.
* Problem\-solver with a drive to take ownership.
* Strong analytical abilities and excellent presentation skills.
* Proficient in financial modelling, with experience developing spreadsheet\-based models. Experience with econometric modelling is a plus.
* Ability to work hands\-on and multitask in an energetic environment.
* Up to date with global events, with an interest in energy and environmental sciences.
* Passionate about presenting and discussing research findings with senior audiences and industry experts.



  





**You Must Have** 



* A Master's degree in engineering, an MBA, or a related degree.
* Demonstrated research, education, or work experience related to transportation, climate change, energy, or public policy.
* Experience as an author or co\-author of papers, technical or policy reports, white papers, or other forms of written communication.
* 4–7 years of relevant consulting experience in a related field, such as clean fuel programs, biofuels, oil \& gas, energy transition, sustainability and low\-carbon transition, or renewable energy.

title: Growth Manager-Ecommerce
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Growth Manager\-Ecommerce** 
 to own and scale our online business across D2C, marketplaces and quick\-commerce platforms with a primary focus on Amazon and Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate understands that e\-commerce is not just about managing listings \- it’s about driving sales, improving visibility, increasing conversion, ensuring product availability and building profitable \& sustainable growth. You should be comfortable working with data, managing multiple platforms and identifying opportunities to grow the business.
 



  





 If you enjoy taking ownership, working fast and directly impacting online revenue and business growth, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**About Ayuvya** 




 Ayuvya is a modern Ayurveda and wellness brand built around trust, authenticity and innovation, combining traditional Ayurvedic wisdom with modern science and technology.
 



  





 We are building modern Indian wellness brands across D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce, with a strong focus on building scalable and profitable digital businesses.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own and scale Amazon \& Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels, while managing the broader D2C, marketplace and quick\-commerce business.
* Drive sales targets for the overall brand, hero products and key categories, while owning channel P\&L, margins, CAC and contribution.
* Own forecasting, budgeting, revenue planning and profitability across e\-commerce channels.
* Manage product listings, catalogue, assortment, pricing and promotions across platforms.
* Optimize product pages for SEO, visibility, conversion and platform merchandising.
* Plan and execute media, promotional and marketplace campaigns with the marketing team.
* Monitor competitors, pricing, keywords, rankings, reviews and category trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Track inventory, stock availability, orders, cancellations, returns and fulfilment in coordination with supply chain and operations.
* Analyze sales and platform data to track revenue, conversion, AOV, ROAS, margins and overall channel performance.
* Manage new product launches, SKU additions and platform onboarding.
* Manage marketplace, agency and vendor relationships and drive commercial negotiations.
* Coordinate with marketing, supply chain, operations, finance, CRM and distribution teams.
* Define long\-term channel strategy and growth roadmap and drive continuous experimentation and improvement.
* Prepare regular performance reports and share key insights and action plans with leadership.



  





**Requirements** 



* B.Tech or MBA in Sales \& Marketing / Business or a relevant field.
* 3–5 years of experience in e\-commerce, growth, marketplace management or key account management. Hands\-on experience with major marketplace or quick\-commerce platforms.
* Experience as a Category Manager with an online retailer, KAM for an E\-commerce channel with a leading brand or KAM in Modern Trade is a strong fit.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, e\-commerce operations and platform dashboards.
* Good understanding of SEO, product pages and conversion optimization.
* Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, margins and marketplace profitability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify the root cause of problems and make decisions with imperfect information.
* Strong negotiation and commercial skills with the ability to create win\-win outcomes.
* Strong solutioning ability with a creative and problem\-solving mindset.
* Strong customer orientation and interest in consumer internet and digital commerce.
* Detail\-oriented, organized and execution\-focused.
* Experience in D2C, FMCG, Wellness, Ayurveda, Beauty or Lifestyle is a plus.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Someone who understands what drives online sales and can turn data into action.
* A self\-driven professional who takes ownership and continuously looks for ways to improve sales, visibility, conversion, availability and profitability.
* Someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Someone who is commercially sharp, data\-driven and comfortable solving ambiguous problems.
* Someone who enjoys working across platforms, teams and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 



* You enjoy working with data, platforms and products.
* You can manage multiple platforms, stakeholders and priorities.
* You enjoy working in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment.
* You’re excited about D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce and the consumer internet space.
* You enjoy experimentation and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than friction.



  





**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If** 



* You see e\-commerce only as a listing/uploading job.
* You prefer following instructions rather than taking ownership.
* You’re uncomfortable with numbers, P\&L and performance metrics.
* You don’t enjoy working across multiple teams, platforms and external partners.
* You’re not comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.

**Senior\- FTS\&V (Process/TOM)**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
 As part of our EY \- Finance Consulting Team, you will help clients develop their Performance Improvement initiatives and identify potential opportunities for performance improvements drive them. This includes techno\-functional role conducting finance processes assessments, deep diving and analysing pain areas and coming up with solutions. The client base spans across industries and countries.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Consultant / Sr. Consultant with expertise in Process Assessment assignments with process mapping experience. Also, experience in FP\&A, Financial Accounting and Reporting domain is an added advantage to join the global EY \- Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Experience with finance functions – ‘Record to report’, ‘Procure to pay’ and ‘Order to cash’ processes involving account reconciliations, Journals, Transaction matching, Variance analysis, intercompany and Fixed assets accounting / management
* Conduct workshops with clients to perform current state As\-Is process assessment and design \& optimize Future state processes as per leading practices \& industry benchmarks
* Identify process improvement opportunities using automation, technology upgradation \& process standardization, Finance Transformation and Operation model design and Assessments
* Create L1\-L5 “As\-Is” and “To\-Be” process mapping using tools such as Planview, Nimbus, ARIS, IBM Blueworks and Visio
* Experience in implementation and development of process mapping tools for business functions

* Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure
* Open to travel (Domestic \& International)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting experience is a good to have
* Confident \& professional communication style
* Proficiency in English (oral and written)
* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
* Capability to influence others and move toward a common vision or goal
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
* Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem\-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
* 1\-2 years (for Staff level) and 3\-6 years (for Senior level) of work experience in Finance domain

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills, stakeholder management

**What We Look For**

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
